# Structural Learning

> > Evidence-based teaching platform combining metacognitive frameworks, AI lesson planning, and hands-on classroom tools to develop critical thinking and learning skills in UK schools.

Structural Learning serves 400+ UK schools with research-backed cognitive science tools, professional development, and digital resources grounded in learning theory. The platform integrates the Universal Thinking Framework, Writer's Block writing scaffold, and Oracy tools with AI-powered lesson planning and visual learning aids.

## Key Topics

- Metacognition
- Thinking Framework
- Cognitive Science
- Critical Thinking
- Lesson Planning
- Writer's Block
- Oracy
- Visual Tools
- Learning Skills Framework
- Gagné's Nine Events of Instruction
- Ausubel's Meaningful Learning Theory
- Professional Development
- Teacher Workshops
- Classroom Practice
- Student Engagement

## Core Products & Platforms

- [Thinking Skills Toolkit for Teachers - Plans and Pricing](https://www.structural-learning.com/landing-thinking-framework): Pricing and features for Thinking Framework with 30 skill cards and AI lesson planning.
- [Writer's Block | Hands-On Writing Tool for Schools](https://www.structural-learning.com/block): Product page for Writer's Block hands-on writing scaffold with AI activity matching.
- [Oracy | Structural Learning Toolkit](https://www.structural-learning.com/landing-oracy): Oracy tool for building confident speakers with AI-designed discussion prompts.
- [Plan Lessons That Build Critical Thinking | Membership](https://www.structural-learning.com/membership): Membership platform for lesson planning with Thinking Framework and visual tools.

## Learning Frameworks & Theory

- [Learning Skills Framework](https://www.structural-learning.com/learning-skills-framework): Framework for developing metacognitive skills and academic attributes in learners.
- [Gagné's Nine Events of Instruction: A Teacher's Guide to Effective Lesson Design](https://www.structural-learning.com/post/gagnes-nine-events-of-instruction-teachers-guide): Teacher guide to Gagné's instructional design framework with classroom examples.
- [Ausubel's Meaningful Learning Theory: A Teacher's Guide to Advance Organisers](https://www.structural-learning.com/post/ausubels-meaningful-learning-theory-teachers-guide): Guide to Ausubel's meaningful learning theory and advance organiser strategies.

## Teaching Resources & Tools

- [Visual Tools | Structural Learning Toolkit](https://www.structural-learning.com/visual-tools): Guide to graphic organisers like Fishbone, Diamond 9, and AI-recommended visual tools.
- [Education Blog | Evidence-Based Teaching Strategies](https://www.structural-learning.com/blog): 500+ research-backed articles on cognitive science, metacognition, and classroom practice.
- [Shop | Classroom Kits & Digital Resources](https://www.structural-learning.com/store): E-commerce store for Writer's Block kits and digital teaching resources.
